payload.description: Implement control-plane guardrails for long-running command evaluations so tasks cannot loop invisibly and cancellation becomes deterministic. Scope: enforce bounded retry budgets at command step and item level with no unbounded nested retries. Scope: add stale-progress watchdog semantics based on heartbeat and progress deltas rather than fixed wall-clock timeout. Scope: enforce cancellation SLA by acknowledging cancel request and forcing terminal cancellation when grace window expires. Scope: surface machine-readable failure and cancellation reasons in Task status updates for UI clarity. Acceptance: local tests prove retries stop at configured budget. Acceptance: local tests prove stale-progress transitions to terminal failure with explicit reason. Acceptance: local tests prove cancel request reaches terminal cancelled state even if worker dies. Acceptance: staging run demonstrates visible terminal state transitions without indefinite Processing.
payload.title: Add command task runtime guardrails and cancellation finalization
